native_agent_bootstrap_gap.shared_behavior: Make each host's bundled SpecKit Pro native-agent roster available through its documented runtime surface, verify the host-specific roster, and prove one canonical role can be invoked.

claude_counterpart.availability: An enabled Claude plugin exposes plugin-root agents/*.md without copying them into .claude/agents or ~/.claude/agents. Invoke a required role as speckit-pro:<agent> through Agent.
deterministic_checks: Resolve the loaded plugin root and require the exact Claude-required regular-file roster under agents/ with no symlinks, missing names, or unexpected names.
Validate required Markdown frontmatter and reject Claude-plugin-unsupported agent fields.
In integration evidence, require one successful Agent call whose subagent_type normalizes from speckit-pro:<agent> to the canonical role and whose child completes.

codex_counterpart.availability: Run the existing install-codex-agents helper in a disposable project or isolated fake HOME, then require the installed host-specific roster and restart-required result.
toml_specific_checks: Accept only the current project .codex/agents directory or isolated-home ~/.codex/agents directory; reject symlink traversal and arbitrary destinations.
Parse every source and destination as TOML and require name, description, and developer_instructions with the runner-owned required roster.
Bind each destination file to its rendered source bytes and SHA-256, including model and reasoning policy rewrites.
Preserve unrelated user agents, publish without clobbering concurrent changes, verify the full batch, and roll back fail-closed on partial failure.
Require restart_required after changed writes and false after a verified no-op reinstall.

non_goals: Do not create a Claude install skill.
Do not require equal host roster counts or equal Markdown/TOML bytes.
Do not change real CLI authentication or real user configuration during deterministic tests.
Do not treat interactive Claude teams as a headless Agent substitute.

official.finding: Plugin-provided Claude subagents are loaded from a plugin agents directory and use scoped plugin-name:agent-name invocation.
Claude plugin agents live at plugin-root agents/*.md and are available through native agent discovery/invocation.
Codex custom agents are standalone TOML files under project .codex/agents or personal ~/.codex/agents.
